notes: The Tampere PDF is reachable (Title 'Element Biosciences AVITI EURO 2025 Price List V7', created 2025-11-12, modified 2026-04-02). The fetch tool could not decompress its FlateDecode content stream, and I had no Bash or PDF renderer here, so I extracted no table. Only one price is confirmed, from a search-result snippet: the AVITI 2x75 Cloudbreak FS High Output kit (cat. 860-00015) at €1,077.75 for 150 Gb and 1B reads. That works out to about €7.19/Gb (€1.08 per M reads) before PhiX and library prep. It is a single point and is not compared with Illumina. Searches found no tuni.fi page hosting an Illumina or MGI price list. I found no Hilma award notice on hankintailmoitukset.fi, since search does not index it. The Nordic and Spanish tenders surfaced are not new: the Copenhagen X Plus award is a USD instrument purchase, the Turku NovaSeq X tender (2024) is an instrument purchase, and the Clinic Barcelona 25B tender (30 Jul 2026) is a 64-lane service tender on TED. The Barcelona notice may be worth one check for a price or award value, but the corpus already holds similar EU tenders (CIBER, IDIBAPS).
how_to_mine: Download the PDF and extract it locally with pdfplumber, PyMuPDF or pdftotext (not WebFetch), then pull every kit row (cat. no., reads, Gb, € price). Compute €/Gb for the 2x75, 2x150 and 2x300 kits at High, Medium and Low Output, and for AVITI24. Compare with the Illumina 25B list of $2.07-2.74/Gb on spec output (known) converted to EUR. Also check TED notice 528143-2026 / 536530-2026 (Clinic Barcelona, 25B lanes) for award value per flow cell. The Hilma portal is a JavaScript app, so use TED or Mercell for Finnish notices.

items.label: 1B
items.claim: A European university list shows Element AVITI Cloudbreak FS High Output 2x75 at about €7.19/Gb (€1,077.75 for 150 Gb).
items.detail: The Tampere University-hosted Element EURO 2025 price list (V7, modified 2 Apr 2026) prices kit 860-00015 at €1,077.75 for 1B reads and 150 Gb. That is about €7.19/Gb and €1.08 per M reads. The 2x75 kit is Element's priciest per-Gb format, so it is a ceiling point, not the headline. The full table (2x150 and larger-output kits) is unread. The comparison with Illumina 25B €/Gb is therefore incomplete.
items.source_name: Tampere University-hosted Element AVITI EURO price list
items.why_new: The corpus has only US core AVITI rates and no Element euro list price.
